body_markdown:
ATHENS, Greece, May 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Dynagas LNG Partners LP (NYSE: “DLNG”) (“Dynagas Partners” or the “Partnership”), an owner of LNG carriers, today announced that it will release its financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026, before market opens in New York on Friday, May 29, 2026.


An accompanying slide presentation of the first quarter 2026 financial results will be available on the Dynagas LNG Partners website under the[Presentations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HuSbVEmcgGlT30-4Fghz7UgZ8WS4-hgtCOTgl1Ih2LNnSHhUpHBG2GX8p1noRCmWQ1VN4kdCPg1JuWzK9BuzBd5HcTVZhGz32T2k0pqCyNlZZRO6IAMJyym1_CCUNK_F) section of the Investor Relations page.


**About Dynagas** **LNG** **Partners** **LP**


Dynagas LNG Partners LP (NYSE: DLNG) is a master limited partnership which owns and operates LNG carriers employed on multi-year charters. The Partnership’s current fleet consists of six LNG carriers, with aggregate carrying capacity of approximately 914,000 cubic meters.


Visit the Partnership’s website at[www.dynagaspartners.com.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=e_aBjyOwOxGtM2M20-ozGD0rxaQv-zKQJz3zoVe11TlcO50bGQ8kcRWo4EAjXlJRhTepBmgDnQ5FV6rCv6Q4uFYO-W8V2kJXrM6PIasr_2NZHzo-N6XPoAUlW15eqQGc)
